description: For teams that run their own AiNxt Platform (ainxt-enterprise) for shared auth, budgets, policy and audit. Not required to use AiNxt at all — see the "Standalone" profile if you just want the CLI talking directly to a model.
notes: gatewayUrl points at a local gateway. Change it to wherever yours runs.
model is intentionally empty: the agent's own default applies, so this profile does not pin you to a provider.
allowInsecure is false. It relaxes certificate validation for an internally-issued CA; it does NOT permit plain HTTP to a non-loopback host.
binaryPath is empty, so the `ainxt` binary is resolved from PATH.
No API key is stored here. Profiles are not secrets - the key lives in the IDE's SecretStorage.
